environment.description: Same ASP.NET Core 8 API deployed on Azure App Service with Azure SQL. The database connection string references a contained database user 'vault_reader_7f2a' which was provisioned through an ARM template with a narrowly-scoped custom database role 'role_secret_readonly'. This role was granted via: GRANT SELECT ON dbo.secrets TO role_secret_readonly; with no additional DML permissions. The user has no membership in db_datawriter, db_ddladmin, or any other built-in roles. An explicit DENY INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON SCHEMA::dbo TO vault_reader_7f2a is also applied at the schema level. Azure SQL auditing is enabled with diagnostic logs shipped to Log Analytics workspace 'vault-la-prod'. The application's managed identity has no Azure RBAC data-plane write permissions on the SQL server resource.

config.explicit_deny: DENY INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON SCHEMA::dbo TO vault_reader_7f2a
config.network: private endpoint only, NSG restricts to App Service subnet
config.managed_identity_rbac: Reader role only on SQL server resource
